title: Bounded-Inventory Market Making (Guéant, Lehalle & Fernandez-Tapia)
holding_period: seconds to minutes; continuous two-sided quoting with a hard inventory bound
data_requirements: level-1 or level-2 limit order book data
individual fill records with quote distance, for calibrating A and k
high-frequency realised volatility estimate for sigma
capital and margin limits to set the inventory bound Q

sources.citation: Guéant, O., Lehalle, C.-A., & Fernandez-Tapia, J. Dealing with the Inventory Risk: A solution to the market making problem. arXiv:1105.3115v5 (July 2012 draft); published in Mathematics and Financial Economics 7(4), 477-507 (2013).
Avellaneda, M., & Stoikov, S. (2008). High-frequency trading in a limit order book. Quantitative Finance, 8(3), 217-224. (The parent model.)
Ho, T., & Stoll, H. R. (1981). Optimal dealer pricing under transactions and return uncertainty. Journal of Financial Economics, 9(1), 47-73.
